name: Patient Appointment Reminder
description: Runs daily to query upcoming patient appointments from the clinic database, filters for appointments within the next 24-48 hours, and sends personalized SMS and email reminders to each patient with appointment details, provider name, and preparation instructions. Reduces no-show rates for healthcare clinics and hospitals.

config.query: SELECT a.id, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration_minutes, a.notes, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.phone, p.email, p.preferred_language, d.name as provider_name, d.specialty, l.address as location_address, l.name as location_name FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.id JOIN providers d ON a.provider_id = d.id JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.id WHERE a.appointment_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '2 days' AND a.status = 'confirmed' AND a.reminder_sent = false ORDER BY a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time

data.label: Filter patients with valid contact info

config.description: Exclude patients who have no phone and no email on file

data.label: Mark reminder as sent in database

config.query: UPDATE appointments SET reminder_sent = true, reminder_sent_at = NOW(), reminder_channel = '{{channelUsed}}' WHERE id = {{appointment.id}}
